All teacher contact and content information will be found within Schoology. All AP students will be given Learning Targets (LTs) at the beginning of each unit. The LTs will include the unit essential questions students need to be able to answer by the end of each unit, the daily learning targets, all tested content concepts/vocabulary terms, the daily agenda and ALL assessment dates. The LTs are also intended to be used as a study tool. 

I HIGHLY recommend that you form outside study groups to help prepare for the class assessments AND the AP exam in May 2026.

"Rather fail with honor than succeed by fraud."
-Sophocles
